comment: Patterns excluded from `pnpm test:quick`. The `test:quick` script in the root package.json is the command source of truth; scripts/tests/check-quick-exclusions.mjs enforces parity, flags stale patterns, and prints the excluded file count.

exclusions.reason: Full-run replay through the CLI entry point (spawns node, replays a whole season).
Season block golden/iteration suites (seeded full-block simulations).
AI league generation and reachability cohorts.
CLI integration tiers (league generation, draft duel catalog).
